Interactive experiments demonstrate SU(2) spinors, Bloch vectors, and 2π/4π periodicity; SU(3) state transformations, generators, weight diagrams of the fundamental representation, and commutation relations. Applications calculate Rabi oscillations, SU(2) angular-momentum coupling and exchange levels, tensor-product decompositions of SU(3) Dynkin representations, complete SU(3) CG matrices, and bidirectional basis transformations. Each CG input satisfies p+q≤4; the product space is limited to dimension 256 numerically and 81 in exact mode. Radical coefficients, exact complex amplitudes, and bidirectional transformations are supported, with exchange symmetry distinguishing repeated octets. The Racah (6j) experiment compares left and right coupling paths in triple tensor products, calculating exact recoupling matrices, two levels of outer multiplicity, and complex amplitudes. It supports six types of input factors and a total space of at most 512 dimensions; the matrix acts in the multiplicity space of a selected final representation. The 9j experiment compares pairwise couplings in fourfold tensor products, retaining outer multiplicity at all three vertices of each path and restoring the correct factor-coordinate order. It provides exact recoupling and dimension-reduced 9j coefficients. Inputs include all 15 representations with p+q≤4, including 10, 15, 15′, 24, 27 and conjugates, with total dimension at most 4096. Higher-dimensional inputs generate exact CG weight blocks on demand; presets for 10, 15, and 27 inputs support complex-amplitude round trips. For 8⊗8⊗8⊗8, final representations 1, 8, and 27 have 8, 32, and 33 paths, respectively, with matrix pagination and channel selection. 用操作复合解释四条群公理: Explain the four group axioms through operation composition
不同操作为 E、R、R²、R³，乘法用 R⁴ = E 化简。: The distinct operations are E, R, R², R³; multiplication simplifies using R⁴ = E.
一个对称轴可以提供多个操作。操作复合有先后次序，矩阵从右往左作用。: One symmetry axis can supply several operations. Composition has an order: matrices act from right to left.
R² 不在集合中，违反封闭性: R² is outside the set, violating closure
C₄ 中 180° 旋转 R² 的阶是多少？: What is the order of the 180° rotation R² in C₄?
用坐标变换理解 Schönflies 与 Hermann–Mauguin 两种记: Understand Schönflies and Hermann–Mauguin notation through coordinate transformations.
在正交笛卡尔基底中 RᵀR = I。正旋转满足 det R = +1，镜面、反演: In an orthonormal Cartesian basis, RᵀR = I. Proper rotations have det R = +1; improper operations such as mirrors and inversion have det R = −1. The determinant indicates whether spatial handedness is reversed but does not uniquely identify the operation.
2̄ = iC₂ 等于垂直该轴的镜面，所以写作 m。同一定向轴上的 4̄ 与 S: 2̄ = iC₂ is the mirror perpendicular to the axis, written m. For the same oriented axis, 4̄ and S₄ are inverse operations but generate the same four-element group. Thus the international group name −4 corresponds to the Schönflies name S₄. Corresponding group names do not imply identical directions for their basic operations.
4mm 的两个 m 表示两组不等价的竖直镜面。4/m 的斜杠表示镜面法线与轴平行: The two m symbols in 4mm denote two inequivalent sets of vertical mirrors. The slash in 4/m means that the mirror normal is parallel to the axis, so the mirror is perpendicular to it. 422 has a principal fourfold axis and two sets of perpendicular twofold axes. Cubic groups use different direction conventions and should be read together with operation matrices.
2/m 必然包含反演。C₂ 与包含轴的镜面生成的 mm2（C₂v），则没有反演。: 2/m necessarily contains inversion. By contrast, mm2 (C₂v), generated by C₂ and a mirror containing its axis, has no inversion.
从晶体学限制出发，按七个晶系整理全部普通晶体学点群。: Start from the crystallographic restriction and organize all ordinary crystallographic point groups by the seven crystal systems.
有限阶旋转因此只允许 1、2、3、4、6 重轴。进一步要求镜面、反演及旋转的组合: Finite-order rotations therefore allow only axes of order 1, 2, 3, 4, or 6. Requiring closure of combinations with mirrors and inversion, and classifying their three-dimensional geometric actions, gives 32 types. The restriction concerns three-dimensional periodic lattices; fivefold symmetry in isolated molecules and quasicrystals is consistent with it.
本课程采用常见国际短符号，−n 代替上划线 n。mm2 若以 z 为二重轴，两镜: This course uses common international short symbols, with −n replacing an overlined n. In mm2 with the twofold axis along z, the mirrors are xz and yz. Changing axes can give 2mm or m2m while retaining geometric type C₂v, but operation matrices and basis functions must transform with the coordinates.
三方：3（C₃）、−3（C₃ᵢ，也写 S₆）、32（D₃）、3m（C₃v）、−3: Trigonal: 3 (C₃), −3 (C₃ᵢ, also S₆), 32 (D₃), 3m (C₃v), −3m (D₃d). Trigonal names a crystal system; rhombohedral describes a related lattice or cell setting and is not fully synonymous.
立方：23（T）、m−3（Tₕ）、432（O）、−43m（Tᵈ）、m−3m（Oₕ: Cubic: 23 (T), m−3 (Tₕ), 432 (O), −43m (Tᵈ), m−3m (Oₕ). All have four threefold axes rather than a unique principal axis, and orders 12, 24, 24, 24, 48 respectively. The total is 2+3+3+7+5+7+5 = 32.
都有四重轴，为何 4、4mm、4/mmm 不同？: All have fourfold axes: why do 4, 4mm, and 4/mmm differ?
4/mmm 包含水平镜面及对应复合操作，共 16 个操作，且有反演。: 4/mmm includes a horizontal mirror and the associated composite operations, giving 16 operations and inversion symmetry.
32 是几何类型数，既不是所有有限点群数，也不是抽象群同构类型数。C₂、Cₛ、C: 32 counts geometric types, not all finite point groups or abstract group isomorphism types. C₂, Cₛ, and Cᵢ are all abstractly isomorphic to the cyclic group of order two, but act differently in space.
不违反，限制针对三维周期晶格: No contradiction: the restriction applies to three-dimensional periodic lattices
两种晶体都属于 m−3m，能确定其空间群相同吗？: If two crystals both belong to m−3m, must their space groups be identical?
不能，点群不保留全部平移与非点式操作: No; the point group omits full translation and nonsymmorphic information
表示描述某组物理量如何变换，共轭类与特征标让矩阵信息便于比较。: Representations describe how physical quantities transform; conjugacy classes and characters make matrix information easier to compare.
读懂共轭类、维数和特征标: Read conjugacy classes, dimensions, and characters
矩阵必须保持群乘法。换基后，全部矩阵同时变为 S⁻¹D(g)S，仍是等价表示；不: The matrices must preserve group multiplication. A basis change sends every matrix simultaneously to S⁻¹D(g)S and gives an equivalent representation. Incompatible bases cannot be chosen separately for individual operations.
在 C₄v 中，极矢量空间分成 z 的一维空间与 (x,y) 的二维空间。所有群: In C₄v, the polar-vector space splits into the one-dimensional z space and the two-dimensional (x,y) space. Every group operation preserves both subspaces, corresponding to A₁ and E, so the vector representation is A₁ ⊕ E. E as a representation name differs from the identity operation; context distinguishes them.
特征标 χ(g) 是矩阵 D(g) 的迹，同类内相同且不随基底改变。字符表每列通: The character χ(g) is the trace of D(g), constant within a conjugacy class and independent of basis. Each character-table column usually represents a class; numbers such as 2, 3, and 6 in headings are class sizes and must enter calculations. The identity character χ(E) = d gives the representation dimension.
90° 旋转迹为 1，180° 旋转迹为 −1；镜面矩阵有两个 +1 和一个 −: A 90° rotation has trace 1 and a 180° rotation trace −1. A mirror has two +1 eigenvalues and one −1 eigenvalue, giving trace 1.
三维矢量不必构成三维不可约表示；在 C₄v 中，它拆成一维 A₁ 与二维 E。: A three-dimensional vector need not form a three-dimensional irreducible representation: in C₄v it splits into one-dimensional A₁ and two-dimensional E.
群只有两个操作: The group has only two operations
单位操作由 d×d 单位矩阵表示，迹为 d，不直接给出群阶。: The identity is represented by a d×d identity matrix with trace d; this does not directly give the group order.
每个操作各挑任意基底: Choose any basis separately for each operation
区分直和与张量积: Distinguish direct sums from tensor products
设 h 为群阶，n꜀ 为第 c 个类的大小，χ 为待分解特征标，χᵅ 为不可约表: Let h be the group order, n꜀ the size of class c, χ the character to decompose, and χᵅ the character of irreducible representation α. Their inner product, weighted by class sizes and divided by h, gives the multiplicity aᵅ. The star denotes complex conjugation.
二重轴取 z，列按 E、C₂(z)、σ(xz)、σ(yz)，每个类大小均为 1。: Take the twofold axis along z and columns E, C₂(z), σ(xz), σ(yz); every class has size 1. The four irreducible representations are A₁: (1,1,1,1), A₂: (1,1,−1,−1), B₁: (1,−1,1,−1), B₂: (1,−1,−1,1).
两个子空间并排构成大空间是直和，特征标逐项相加。联合两个对象，例如两个函数的乘积: Placing two subspaces side by side gives a direct sum, whose characters add componentwise. Combining two objects, such as a product of functions, uses a tensor product: multiply characters componentwise and then reduce.
坐标矩阵给出 χᵥ = (3,−1,1,1)，群阶 h = 4。: Coordinate matrices give χᵥ = (3,−1,1,1), with group order h = 4.
逐操作列表直接对每个操作求和；按类压缩的列表才乘类大小。漏权重或重复乘权重都会得: For an operation-by-operation list, sum over every operation directly. Multiply by class sizes only for a class-compressed list. Missing or double-counting weights gives incorrect results.
8，等于操作总数: 8, equal to the number of operations
本课 C₂v 约定下，B₁ ⊗ B₂ 等于什么？: In this lesson's C₂v convention, what is B₁ ⊗ B₂?
从表示重数走向具体函数，用加权平均筛选对称成分。: Go from representation multiplicities to explicit functions, extracting symmetry components by weighted averaging.
标量函数约定为 T(g)f(r) = f(Rg⁻¹r)，从而保持 T(g)T(h: The scalar-function convention is T(g)f(r) = f(Rg⁻¹r), preserving T(g)T(h) = T(gh). A character projector extracts all components of type α; it does not automatically select a particular partner in a multidimensional representation or distinguish repeated copies.
零投影只表示这个试探函数没有目标成分，不表示群不存在这种表示。可以换函数，或从整: A zero projection means only that the trial function lacks the target component, not that the group lacks that representation. Try another function or start from a complete set of orbitals, displacements, or polynomials.
实际基函数空间必须在群作用下封闭。例如选择某原子的 x 位移后，应同时纳入操作能: The chosen basis-function space must be closed under the group action. For example, after choosing one atom's x displacement, include displacements of all other atoms and directions generated by operations, or degrees of freedom will be lost.
用 A₁ 权重 (1,1,1,1) 求平均，得到 z。: Average with A₁ weights (1,1,1,1) to obtain z.
四个结果相加，重新得到原函数。: The four results add back to the original function.
A₁ 投影作用于 C₂v 中的 x 为零，意味着什么？: What does a zero A₁ projection of x in C₂v mean?
该对称类型子空间中的成分: The component in the subspace of that symmetry type
伙伴、重数副本和归一化需要额外处理；频率还需动力学信息。: Partners, multiplicity copies, and normalization require further treatment; frequencies also require dynamical information.
位置与角动量的变换不同: Position and angular momentum transform differently
极性是整个群的不变矢量: Polarity requires a vector invariant under the whole group
IR 看一次坐标，普通 Raman 看二次坐标: IR probes linear coordinates; ordinary Raman probes quadratic coordinates
含反演时，电偶极为奇宇称，普通 Raman 二次坐标为偶宇称，所以同一确定宇称的: With inversion, the electric dipole has odd parity and ordinary Raman quadratic coordinates have even parity. Thus a vibrational mode of definite parity cannot have both first-order activities. But even parity alone does not ensure Raman activity, nor odd parity IR activity; the actual representation and polarization matter. Modes of different parity can also accidentally share a frequency.
三维晶体原胞有 N 个原子时，Γ 点共有 3N 个声子分支，其中 3 个为声学支: A three-dimensional crystal with N atoms per primitive cell has 3N phonon branches at Γ, including three acoustic branches; overall rotations must not be subtracted as for molecules. Frequencies, intensities, and eigenvectors require force constants and dipole or polarizability derivatives. An IR-allowed character-table type need not occur among a specific structure's optical vibrations.
乘极矢量字符 (3,−1,1,1)，得到 9 维位移表示字符 (9,−1,3,1: Multiply by the polar-vector characters (3,−1,1,1) to obtain the nine-dimensional displacement characters (9,−1,3,1).
两个 A₁ 对应对称伸缩与弯曲，B₁ 对应反对称伸缩。交换 x、y 后常写成 2: The two A₁ modes are symmetric stretching and bending; B₁ is antisymmetric stretching. Exchanging x and y often changes the notation to 2A₁+B₂ without changing the physical modes. Frequencies and intensities are not calculated here.
L = r×p，反演同时改变 r、p 的符号，叉积不变；时间反演是另一种操作。: L = r×p: inversion reverses both r and p, leaving their cross product unchanged. Time reversal is a different operation.
能，所有允许峰等强: Yes; all allowed peaks have equal intensity

保留非 Γ 点的平移相位: Retain translation phases away from Γ
晶体点群由空间群的线性部分组成，与对纯平移取商的群同构。位点对称群只保留固定某一: The crystal point group consists of the linear parts of space-group operations and is isomorphic to the quotient by pure translations. A site-symmetry group retains only operations fixing an atomic position and can be much smaller. Bands or phonons at wave vector k use the little group that preserves k modulo a reciprocal-lattice vector.
为什么普通点群表还不够: Why ordinary point-group tables are insufficient
有自旋或磁性时继续扩展: Extend further for spin or magnetism
普通空间群工作台选 No.99，P4mm，单值表示与 Γ 点 (0,0,0)。它: In the ordinary space-group workbench, choose No.99, P4mm, single-valued representations, and Γ=(0,0,0). This symmorphic space group has translation phase 1 at Γ and can be checked against C₄v.
点群给出几何与代数基础；真实能带、声子还需空间群、波矢和平移相位。: Point groups provide geometric and algebraic foundations; actual bands and phonons also require space groups, wave vectors, and translation phases.
须先选择 k 小群并保留平移相位；非对称型空间群还可能有非平凡因子系统。: First select the k little group and retain translation phases; nonsymmorphic space groups can also have nontrivial factor systems.
序参量、剩余对称性与不变量: Order parameters, residual symmetries, and invariants
C₄ᵥ：二维序参量（x、y 分量）: C₄ᵥ: two-dimensional order parameter (x and y components)
立方极性序参量：六个轴向畴: Cubic polar order parameter: six axial domains

给立方极向量加入 −h_xη_x 后，六个母群轴向轨道态还全部等能吗？: After adding −h_xη_x to a cubic polar vector, do all six axial states in the parent-group orbit remain degenerate?

无迹对称对角项 Γ_{yy}（单位：meV；Γ_{zz}=−Γ_{xx}−Γ_{: Traceless symmetric diagonal term Γ_{yy} (meV; Γ_{zz}=−Γ_{xx}−Γ_{yy})
DMI 分量 D_z（单位：meV；有向键 i→j）: DMI component D_z (meV; directed bond i→j)
仅换约定：是否交换端点标签 i、j: Convention change only: exchange endpoint labels i and j?
包含键的镜面：只允许法向D: Mirror containing the bond: only normal D is allowed
四重键轴：轴向D与相等横向交换: Fourfold bond axis: axial D and equal transverse exchange
项目：剩余 xz 镜面的磁键: Project: a magnetic bond with a surviving xz mirror
项目：对接 1rad/ns 的反演键: Project: connect to the inversion-symmetric bond at 1rad/ns

逐项检查生成元的对易子与Lindblad伴随作用，比较实际轨迹、时间反演保护和一: Check each generator's commutator and the adjoint Lindblad action, comparing actual trajectories, time-reversal protection, and consistent basis changes.
约定对照：绕y的被动换基角（度）: Convention comparison: passive basis rotation about y (degrees)
XYZ：离散旋转不保证Sz守恒: XYZ: discrete rotations do not guarantee Sz conservation

各向同性交换中，每个交换项与S_x的对易子都必须单独为零吗？: For isotropic exchange, must each exchange term separately commute with S_x?
不必检查对易子: There is no need to check commutators

本课程采用 T(t)ψ(r)=ψ(r−t)。若 ψₖ(r)=exp(2πik·r: This course uses T(t)ψ(r)=ψ(r−t). For ψₖ(r)=exp(2πik·r)uₖ(r), a lattice translation L gives T(L)ψₖ=exp(−2πik·L)ψₖ. Here k is in fractional reciprocal coordinates, so the dot product has no additional unit factor.

这只推导螺旋本征值；能级是否成对简并还取决于其他空间或反幺正对称。: This derives only screw eigenvalues. Paired energy degeneracy also depends on other spatial or antiunitary symmetries.

The two lifts of an original conjugacy class can form one class or split into two; lifts of distinct original classes cannot merge. Choosing one lift per operation usually does not give a closed half: two “unbarred” lifts can multiply into the other half.

用 D(Ē) 的符号区分单值和双值扇区: Distinguish single- and double-valued sectors by the sign of D(Ē)
双值指的是中心元的符号: Double-valued refers to the central element's sign
单值扇区：D(Ē)=+I；双值扇区：D(Ē)=−I: Single-valued sector: D(Ē)=+I; double-valued sector: D(Ē)=−I
对旋转角 θ，自旋 1/2 的特征标是 2cos(θ/2)。张量积的特征标是两个: For rotation angle θ, the spin-1/2 character is 2cos(θ/2). Tensor-product characters multiply those of the factors. Group theory constrains allowed block structure but does not alone give SOC splitting magnitudes, energy ordering, or real material parameters.
角动量相加给出 j=1/2 与 j=3/2，对应 2+4=6 维。: Angular-momentum addition gives j=1/2 and j=3/2, of dimensions 2+4=6.
张量积维数守恒；具体晶体中的标签和简并必须结合该群及时间反演重新判断。: Tensor-product dimension is conserved. Labels and degeneracies in a particular crystal must be assessed using its group and time reversal.
中心元的负号定义双值扇区，维数可为一或更高；时间反演是另一个需要单独加入的条件。: The central minus sign defines the double-valued sector, whose dimension can be one or larger. Time reversal is a separate condition to add explicitly.
反幺正不是负范数: Antiunitarity does not mean negative norm
同能量伙伴未必位于同一个 k: An equal-energy partner need not lie at the same k
0.2 与 −0.2 不等价，时间反演仅要求两处出现同能伙伴。: 0.2 and −0.2 are inequivalent; time reversal requires only equal-energy partners at those two momenta.
净磁矩为零、存在 SOC 或处于 TRIM，都不能单独代替“反幺正对称确实存在且: Zero net moment, SOC, or being at a TRIM cannot individually replace checking that an antiunitary symmetry actually exists and squares to −I.
A=UK 是反幺正算符，其平方应怎样计算？: If A=UK is antiunitary, how is its square calculated?
解释空间反演与时间反演的区别: Explain the difference between spatial inversion and time reversal
空间操作先把原子位置送到 Rx+t。时间偶的极矢量 v（如位移）随旋转矩阵变成: A spatial operation first maps atomic positions to Rx+t. A time-even polar vector v, such as displacement, becomes Rv. A magnetic moment m is a time-odd axial vector and becomes det(R)Rm in orthonormal Cartesian coordinates. Inversion reverses a polar vector but preserves an axial magnetic moment.
对称必须匹配整套结构: Symmetry must match the entire structure
xy 镜面对两种箭头的不同作用: An xy mirror acts differently on the two kinds of arrows
对不带撇的磁矩 m=(1,2,3)，得到 m′=(−1,−2,3)。: For an unprimed magnetic moment m=(1,2,3), m′=(−1,−2,3).
磁矩并非普通位移箭头。尤其在镜面和反演下，漏掉 det(R) 会得到错误磁对称。: A magnetic moment is not an ordinary displacement arrow. Omitting det(R), especially for mirrors and inversion, gives incorrect magnetic symmetry.
一个反铁磁结构的总磁矩等于零，能否据此确定纯时间反演是其对称？: Does zero total moment in an antiferromagnetic structure establish pure time reversal as a symmetry?
能，只要所有原子相同: Yes, if all atoms are identical
记住各类型数量而不把类型当成磁序名称: Remember type counts without treating types as names of magnetic orders
I 类只含普通空间操作，M=H，共 230 个类型。II 类又称灰群，在普通空间: Type I contains only ordinary spatial operations, M=H, with 230 types. Type II, the gray groups, adds a time-reversed partner to every ordinary space-group operation: M=H∪ΘH, also 230 types. Pure Θ is a symmetry in type II.
移去所有撇号后得到普通的家族空间群 F。III 类的 H 与 F 有相同平移晶格: Removing every prime gives the ordinary family space group F. For type III, H and F share a translation lattice, while the point group of H has index 2 in that of F. There are 674 types.
ΘT(a) 同时交换位置并反转磁矩，恢复原磁序；T(2a) 则是酉平移。: ΘT(a) exchanges positions and reverses moments, restoring the order; T(2a) is a unitary translation.
不能把“有磁性”理解成必属 III 类，也不能只根据净磁矩为零选择 IV 类；决: Magnetism does not necessarily imply type III, nor does zero net moment select type IV. The complete operation set determines the type.
IV 类反平移 ΘT(τ) 中，τ 与酉平移晶格的关系是什么？: In a type-IV antitranslation ΘT(τ), how is τ related to the unitary translation lattice?
2τ 也不能是酉平移: 2τ cannot be a unitary translation either
BNS 与 OG 是同一批磁空间群的两种规范描述体系。BNS 常见两段编号，OG: BNS and OG are two standard description systems for the same magnetic space groups. BNS commonly uses two-part numbers and OG three-part numbers. These are identifiers, not decimals, and cannot be converted by string substitution or arithmetic.
忽略空间平移而保留旋转与时间反演标记，可以得到磁点群。三维晶体学磁点群共有 32: Ignoring spatial translations while retaining rotations and time-reversal marks gives a magnetic point group. Three-dimensional crystallographic magnetic point groups comprise 32 types without antiunitary operations, 32 gray types, and 58 black-and-white types: 122 total.
21′ 是灰磁点群，包含 {E,C₂,Θ,ΘC₂}，共有 4 个元素。: 21′ is a gray magnetic point group with {E,C₂,Θ,ΘC₂}, totaling 4 elements.
撇号的位置决定哪些操作与时间反演绑定，不是装饰性字符。: Prime placement determines which operations are tied to time reversal; primes are not decoration.
122=32 个普通型+32 个灰型+58 个黑白型；1651 的四类计数属于磁: 122=32 ordinary + 32 gray + 58 black-and-white types; the four-type count of 1651 concerns magnetic space groups.
按左侧操作类型选择是否共轭右侧矩阵: Use the left operation's type to decide whether to conjugate the right matrix
一个操作由矩阵与反线性标记共同表示: An operation consists of both a matrix and an antilinearity flag
(U_gK^εg)(U_hK^εh)=U_g(U_h 若 εg=0；U_h* 若: (U_gK^εg)(U_hK^εh)=U_g(U_h if εg=0; U_h* if εg=1)K^(εg+εh mod 2)
换基底 S 时，反幺正矩阵部分变成 S⁻¹U_aS*，不是普通相似变换。因此 T: Under a basis change S, an antiunitary matrix part becomes S⁻¹U_aS*, not an ordinary similarity transform. Thus Tr(U_a) generally lacks ordinary characters' basis invariance. Inspect unitary characters, corepresentation type, and antiunitary multiplication checks first; do not insert every antiunitary matrix trace into ordinary group reduction formulas.
反幺正乘法中的共轭是结构的一部分；一维反幺正算符的平方不能为 −I。: Conjugation is structural in antiunitary multiplication; a one-dimensional antiunitary operator cannot square to −I.
UKVK=UV*K²=UV*，左侧的 K 对右侧 V 做复共轭。: UKVK=UV*K²=UV*: the K on the left complex-conjugates V on the right.
推导 A=ΘT(τ) 的平方及 Bloch 相位: Derive the square and Bloch phase of A=ΘT(τ)
平方含有一个真实晶格平移: The square includes an actual lattice translation
A²|ₖ=−exp(−4πik·τ) I（自旋 1/2）；无自旋时前面的 − 改: A²|ₖ=−exp(−4πik·τ) I for spin 1/2; replace the initial − by + for spinless states
在使指数等于 1 的整个平面上，A² 可能恒为 −I，但平面上的一般 k 仍被送: A² can equal −I throughout a plane where the exponential is 1, but a generic k on that plane is still sent to a different −k. This does not establish twofold degeneracy at every k in the plane. Additional k-preserving operations such as PΘ require separate checks.
选择磁晶胞的倒格分数坐标，A²|ₖ=−exp(−2πik_z)。: Using fractional reciprocal coordinates of the magnetic cell, A²|ₖ=−exp(−2πik_z).
在 k=(0.2,0,0)，虽然 A²=−I，A 却把 k 送到不等价的 (−0: At k=(0.2,0,0), A²=−I, but A sends k to inequivalent (−0.2,0,0), linking spectra at two different momenta only.
自旋 1/2、τ=(0,0,1/2)，在 k=(0,0,1/2) 处 A² 是多: For spin 1/2 and τ=(0,0,1/2), what is A² at k=(0,0,1/2)?
因为 −I 不是合法算符: Because −I is not a valid operator
Kramers 型同一 k 配对要求反幺正操作保持该动量子空间；这里的伙伴处于不: Kramers-type pairing at the same k requires the antiunitary operation to preserve that momentum subspace; here its partner lies at a different −k.
区别线性表示、射影表示与物理旋转: Distinguish linear representations, projective representations, and physical rotations
旋量保留了空间矩阵丢掉的信息: Spinors retain information discarded by spatial matrices
若只给普通 D₂ 的每个元素挑一个提升矩阵，就可能有 D(g)D(h)=ω(g,: Choosing one lifted matrix per ordinary D₂ element can give D(g)D(h)=ω(g,h)D(gh), with ω=±1: a projective representation of the ordinary group. Restoring Ē makes the same matrices an ordinary linear representation of the double group. Different lift choices alter some ω values but cannot turn this noncommutative structure into D₂×C₂.
交换顺序，σyσx=−iσz，于是 YX=+iσz=−Z。: Reversing order gives σyσx=−iσz, hence YX=+iσz=−Z.
“双群”指二重覆盖，不表示所有不可约表示都是二维，也不表示每个能级必然二重简并。: Double group means a double cover, not that every irreducible representation is two-dimensional or every level doubly degenerate.
为什么 D₂ 交换，而它的双群 Q₈ 不交换？: Why is D₂ commutative but its double group Q₈ noncommutative?
双群改变了原子坐标: The double group changes atomic coordinates
比较 Γ 与轴向区边界: Compare Γ with an axial zone boundary
取 g={C₂z|(0,0,1/2)}，坐标为分数坐标。普通空间群有 g²=Tz: Take g={C₂z|(0,0,1/2)} in fractional coordinates. In the ordinary space group, g²=Tz. Its spin-1/2 lift ĝ also accumulates a 2π rotation, giving ĝ²=ĒTz. In an infinite crystal, wrapping plots into a cell does not make Tz the identity.
反演不是 SU(2) 中的一次正旋转: Inversion is not a proper rotation in SU(2)
Γ 的双值螺旋平方为 −1，轴向边界的平方为 +1；这是两个明确因子的乘积。: The double-valued screw squares to −1 at Γ and +1 at the axial boundary: the product of two explicit factors.
找到保色核并辨认其商群: Find the color-preserving kernel and identify its quotient
同一个置换必须作用于所有同色点: The same permutation must act on all points of a given color
保色核 H 由不改颜色的空间操作组成，是 G 的正规子群。像 imρ 列出实际出: The color-preserving kernel H contains spatial operations that leave colors unchanged and is normal in G. The image imρ contains the color permutations actually present, which can be a small subgroup of Sₙ. In this lesson's C₃ rotation subgroup, the image is cyclic C₃ and the kernel is the identity. Including triangle mirrors requires separate checks; this experiment does not claim to exhaust that larger group.
晶体学色群的有限标签置换，与粒子物理中 QCD 的连续 SU(3) 色规范群是不: Finite label permutations in crystallographic color groups differ from the continuous SU(3) color gauge group of QCD. Three colors do not automatically produce SU(3).
ρ 的核包含哪些操作？: Which operations belong to the kernel of ρ?
计算组合平移的幂与保色平移核: Calculate powers of combined translations and the color-preserving translation kernel
采用三维晶胞基矢 a、b、c，胞内同一 x,y 柱上放 z=0、1/3、2/3: Use three-dimensional cell vectors a,b,c and three sites on one x,y column at z=0,1/3,2/3, colored red, green, blue. Repeat the entire colored basis along a,b,c. To isolate the mechanism, the experiment checks only the specified translation generator and does not represent this simplified basis as a real ternary material.
第三次操作后发生了什么？: What happens after the third operation?
第三次：z 增加 1，标签回红；原子仍在相邻胞。: After three steps, z increases by 1 and the label returns to red; the atom is still in the neighboring cell.
本模型的最短正向保色 z 平移是多少？: What is the shortest positive color-preserving z translation in this model?
区分颜色交换、磁矩反向和量子时间反演: Distinguish color exchange, moment reversal, and quantum time reversal
对使用两色且具有非平凡交换的单值着色，颜色像为 C₂，保色核 H 的指标为 2。: For single-valued two-coloring with nontrivial exchange, the color image is C₂ and the color-preserving kernel H has index 2. Non-color-preserving operations lie in one coset gH. This explains certain black-and-white patterns and helps interpret primed/unprimed magnetic-group parts, but their physical actions still need separate definitions.
检验算符而不只检验两张图: Test operators, not just two pictures
给相同“翻色”加上不同物理含义: Assign different physical meanings to the same “color flip”
若一个非平凡二色同态满射到 C₂，它的核的指标是多少？: If a nontrivial two-color homomorphism is onto C₂, what is its kernel's index?
电子 Θ² 必须用反幺正矩阵与复共轭计算。: Electronic Θ² must be calculated using an antiunitary matrix and complex conjugation.
区分自旋空间群与 Spin(3): Distinguish spin space groups from Spin(3)
只做一半通常不是对称: Acting on only one part is usually not a symmetry
Spin(3)≅SU(2) 是 SO(3) 的二重覆盖，说明电子旋量的 2π 负: Spin(3)≅SU(2) is the double cover of SO(3), explaining the electronic spinor's 2π minus sign. A spin point group specifies allowed pairings of independent spin and spatial operations for a magnetic structure. For spin-1/2 states, proper spin rotations can be lifted further to SU(2), but coincidence of classical arrows cannot reveal the lift's minus sign.
U=C₂x 把该站点的 +z 磁矩变成 −z。: U=C₂x sends this site's +z moment to −z.
Hamiltonian 在无 SOC 时的全局自旋旋转对称，不表示选定的有序磁畴: Global spin-rotation symmetry of a Hamiltonian without SOC does not mean a chosen ordered domain preserves every global rotation. Distinguish the energy model from the stabilizer of a specific magnetic order.
R 与 U 都必须作用在位置: Both R and U must act on positions
自旋点群与 Spin(3)≅SU(2) 是同一个概念吗？: Are a spin point group and Spin(3)≅SU(2) the same concept?
只在有三个站点时相同: Only when there are three sites
比较反铁磁半平移与三层螺旋的组合操作: Compare combined operations of an antiferromagnetic half translation and a three-layer helix
三维自旋空间操作为 [U∥R|t]，把位置送到 Rr+t，把磁矩送到 Um。操作: A three-dimensional spin-space operation [U∥R|t] sends positions to Rr+t and moments to Um. In composition, spin matrices multiply, while spatial translation must first be rotated by the outer R. The cell basis repeats along a,b,c and cross-cell translations are retained.
去掉平移时别丢掉自旋部分: Do not lose the spin part when removing translation
每一步平移 c/3，并把磁矩在 xy 平面转 120°。: Each step translates by c/3 and rotates moments through 120° in the xy plane.
h³ 是整胞平移，完整 h 的阶仍无限；三幅胞内画面只展示模平移的循环。: h³ is a whole-cell translation, so the full h still has infinite order. The three cell pictures show only the cycle modulo translation.
区别 SO(3) 正旋转与 O(3) 广义自旋操作: Distinguish proper SO(3) rotations from generalized O(3) spin operations
spin-only 操作写作 [U∥E|0]，不交换任何位置，因此要求 Umi=: A spin-only operation [U∥E|0] exchanges no positions, requiring Umi=mi simultaneously at every site. Let W be the linear span of all moments. An orthogonal matrix fixing W pointwise can vary only on its orthogonal complement W⊥; this directly computes the stabilizer here.
不正的自旋矩阵需要物理解释: Improper spin matrices need a physical interpretation
两个不平行的磁矩已张成 xy 平面，因此 rank W=2。: Two nonparallel moments already span the xy plane, so rank W=2.
完整 O(3) 描述中稳定子为二元素镜面群；只看 SO(3) 正旋转则是平凡群。: In the full O(3) description the stabilizer is a two-element mirror group; restricted to proper SO(3) rotations it is trivial.
xy 平面内非共线磁序的 O(3) 稳定子包含哪一个非平凡操作？: Which nontrivial operation belongs to the O(3) stabilizer of noncollinear magnetic order in the xy plane?
写出磁群在自旋空间群中的锁定条件: Write the locking condition for embedding magnetic groups in spin space groups
独立与锁定是两种约束: Independent and locked operations impose different constraints
两站点模型的 [C₂x∥C₂z] 保持指定箭头，却不能满足 U=±C₂z，因此一: In the two-site model, [C₂x∥C₂z] preserves the arrows but fails U=±C₂z, so it generally lies outside the conventional magnetic point group. Likewise a half translation paired with C₂x can be a spin-space symmetry, whereas the same spatial translation permits only U=±I in a conventional magnetic space group. Another operation, [−I∥E|c/2], can reverse moments similarly in a collinear antiferromagnet, but includes time reversal and has a different quantum realization.
ε=1 时要求 U=−Rc=diag(1,1,−1)，仍不相同。: For ε=1, U=−Rc=diag(1,1,−1) is required and still differs.
空间部分为纯平移时，常规磁群允许的 U 是？: For a pure spatial translation, which U are allowed in a conventional magnetic group?
是，只需图样重合: Yes; matching the pattern is sufficient
结构匹配是必要检查之一，不能替代模型的物理对称假设。: Structural matching is a necessary check, not a replacement for physical symmetry assumptions of the model.
官方原型库，核验 No.216 与两类原子的四面体配位；GaAs 模型按 Ga: Official prototype library, verifying No.216 and tetrahedral coordination of two atom types. The GaAs model selects Ga at 4a and As at 4c.
原始 X 射线结构研究；MnF2 在 25°C 为 rutile，a=4.873: Original X-ray structural study: MnF2 is rutile at 25°C with a=4.8734 Å, c=3.3099 Å, u=0.310(3). The lesson uses rounded c/a=0.68 and u=0.310, not a low-temperature refinement.
原始衍射研究，讨论低温晶格畸变及磁结构模型判别；提醒不能从理想立方母相或少量操作: Original diffraction study discussing low-temperature lattice distortion and discrimination of magnetic-structure models. An ideal cubic parent phase or a few operations cannot replace experimental magnetic-group refinement.
先作预测，再逐步展开；所有例题都说明坐标、相位和适用条件。: Predict first, then unfold the derivation. Every worked example states its coordinates, phases, and applicability conditions.
立方常规胞边长为 a。: The cubic conventional cell has edge a.
先数平移等价的格点，再数每个格点上的化学基元；元素标签也属于结构。: First count translation-equivalent lattice points, then the chemical basis at each point; element labels are part of the structure.
把原点 Na 平移到 (1/2,1/2,1/2)，落到 Cl；即使点集重合也没有: Translating the origin Na to (1/2,1/2,1/2) lands on Cl; even if the point set matches, element identities do not.
Bravais 格点数不等于原子数。不能去掉元素标签后再判空间群。: The number of Bravais lattice points differs from the atom count. Do not remove element labels before identifying the space group.
Si：四次带平移旋转留下了什么？: Si: what remains after four rotations with translation?
分数坐标以课堂 Si 立方常规胞为基准。: Fractional coordinates refer to the lesson's cubic conventional Si cell.
采用主动平移 (T_tψ)(r)=ψ(r−t)，全格矢平移在 k 态上产生相位。: Use active translation (T_tψ)(r)=ψ(r−t); full-lattice-vector translations give phases on k states.
这里最后一式只讨论不含自旋回转负号的空间操作；双值表示还要加入 SU(2) 提升: The last expression concerns spatial operations without a spin-rotation minus sign; double-valued representations also need the SU(2) lift. Do not mix these k coordinates directly with the workbench's BC primitive-cell coordinates.
Si 与 GaAs：同一反演为什么一成一败？: Si and GaAs: why does the same inversion succeed in one and fail in the other?
Si 中两套均为 Si；GaAs 中 L 为 Ga，L+d 为 As。: Both sublattices are Si in silicon; in GaAs, L is Ga and L+d is As.
同一几何反演在 Si 中成立，在 GaAs 中不成立；反演中心为 (1/8,1/: The same geometric inversion holds in Si but fails in GaAs; its center is (1/8,1/8,1/8).
反演不能作用于晶体: Inversion cannot act on a crystal
位置集合保持，但化学元素标签未保持。: The position set is preserved, but chemical-element labels are not.
列变换矩阵的行依次为 (1,0,1)、(−1,1,1)、(0,−1,0)，行列式: The column-transformation matrix has rows (1,0,1), (−1,1,1), (0,−1,0), and determinant 2.
a³/2 并不等于“半个化学原胞”：a³ 是立方常规胞体积，化学原胞为 a³/4: a³/2 does not mean half a chemical primitive cell: a³ is the conventional cubic volume and the chemical primitive volume is a³/4.
Si 电子：为什么 C2 的自旋本征值为 ±i？: Si electrons: why are the C2 spin eigenvalues ±i?
将 θ=π 代入，不要误把半角写成整角。: Substitute θ=π; do not replace the half-angle by the full angle.
z 向上、向下自旋分别得到 −i、+i。: Spin up and down along z give −i and +i respectively.
±i 是本题自旋旋转因子的本征值；实际 Bloch 态还可能含轨道表示与平移相位: ±i are eigenvalues of this spin-rotation factor. Actual Bloch states can also contain orbital representations and translation phases.
GaAs：三重旋转的 SU(2) 提升: GaAs: the SU(2) lift of a threefold rotation
在 n·σ 的本征基中，矩阵指数变成两个普通复指数。: In the eigenbasis of n·σ, the matrix exponential becomes two ordinary complex exponentials.
自旋 1/2 的 120° 回转重复三次后，Bloch 自旋方向与旋量分别如何？: After three spin-1/2 rotations through 120°, what happens to the Bloch spin direction and the spinor?
方向与旋量均不变: Both direction and spinor are unchanged
若电子波函数分成相干两路，一路施加 2π 自旋回转，另一路不动，比较单路自旋概率: Split an electron wavefunction into two coherent paths, apply a 2π spin rotation to one and none to the other, then compare single-path spin probabilities with the two-path relative phase.
忽略两路的其他动力学相位，只讨论受控自旋因子。: Ignore other dynamical phases of the paths; consider only the controlled spin factor.
比较两路相对相位: Compare relative phase between the paths
累计 4π 使旋转路恢复原符号，原先的相对相位也恢复。: An accumulated 4π restores the rotated path's sign and the original relative phase.
哪一种比较能让本题中的负号成为可观测的相对相位？: Which comparison makes the minus sign observable as a relative phase here?

E 相对超导凝聚体的化学势。曲线是零温、固定势与固定Δ近似下的谱微分电导；只有E: E is relative to the condensate chemical potential. Curves give zero-T spectral differential conductance at fixed potential and Δ; only E=0 is strict zero-bias linear conductance. No finite-bias self-consistency, nonequilibrium occupations, or I(V).

偶极跃迁守恒自旋并改变轨道宇称；完整末态空间保留核心 SOC 和 p–d 交换。: Dipole transitions conserve spin and reverse orbital parity; the full final space retains core SOC and p–d exchange.

ZXQD0DQXZ 必须是 ZXQD1DQXZ 至 ZXQD2DQXZ 的有限实: ZXQD0DQXZ must be a finite real number from ZXQD1DQXZ to ZXQD2DQXZ
model 仅支持 c4v 或 rashba: model supports only c4v or rashba
镜面算符 M=iσy 满足 M²=−I，因此自旋镜面本征值为 ±i。: Mirror M=iσy has M²=−I, giving spinful eigenvalues ±i.
时间反演 T=iσyK 将 k 与 −k 配对；只在 Γ、X 这两个本路径的 T: T=iσyK pairs k and −k; same-k Kramers degeneracy is guaranteed only at this path's TRIM Γ and X.
限制到 Cs 后 χE=[2,0]；分别与 A'=[1,1]、A''=[1,−1: Restriction to Cs gives χE=[2,0]; inner products with A'=[1,1] and A''=[1,−1] give 1 each.

spin 字段为 <σx,σy,σz>，实际自旋为 ħ/2 倍。: spin gives <σx,σy,σz>; actual spin is ħ/2 times this.

沿用本站 BC 操作设置；群4的 2₁ 轴为 z，不能直接照搬常见 unique: Uses this site's BC operation setting; group 4's 2₁ axis is z. Do not directly copy k-point names from the common unique-b cell.
稳定子：减去整格平移后固定种子: Stabilizer: fixes the seed after subtracting lattice translations

守恒判据是完整算符 L†Q=0，不能由一条期望值恰好平坦的轨迹代替；逐项贡献可以: Conservation requires full operator L†Q=0, not a coincidentally flat expectation along one trajectory. Contributions can cancel. Norms are Frobenius norms; Q values with different dimensions cannot be directly compared.
守恒量实验输入须为对象。: Conservation-experiment input must be an object.
演化未通过迹、厄米性或半正定校验。: Evolution failed trace, Hermiticity, or positive-semidefinite checks.

ZXQD0DQXZ 须为 ZXQD1DQXZ 至 ZXQD2DQXZ 的有限实数: ZXQD0DQXZ must be a finite real number from ZXQD1DQXZ to ZXQD2DQXZ.

绘图可取 r=√density；这是角分布的可视化半径，不是电子真实径向距离。: Plot radius can be r=√density; this visualizes angular distributions, not actual electronic radial distance.
Ds/Dt 是独立现象学能级参数；配体坐标固定为理想几何，不由 Ds/Dt 反推: Ds/Dt are independent phenomenological level parameters. Ligands remain at ideal geometry; Ds/Dt do not infer bond lengths or directly equate their signs with stretching/compression.
e/t₂ 投影权重不是电子占据数；有 SOC 或低对称晶场时，不应把父相轨道标签: e/t₂ projection weights are not electron occupations. With SOC or lower symmetry, parent orbital labels are not strict quantum numbers for every eigenstate.
独立的线性 E⊗e 绝热模型：一个电子二重态耦合两个无量纲约化坐标，不是上方完整: Independent linear adiabatic E⊗e model: one electronic doublet couples to two dimensionless reduced coordinates. It is not an automatic truncation of the full d⊗spin Hamiltonian above and has no SOC.
圆形极小谷来自线性模型的偶然连续简并，不意味着真实晶体有连续空间旋转对称性；高阶: The circular valley is an accidental continuous degeneracy of the linear model, not continuous crystal rotation symmetry. Higher-order coupling/environmental anisotropy can select discrete distortions.

γ₁、γ_φ 为固定现象学速率；每个自旋独立耦合所选 Markov 通道。没有非: γ₁,γ_φ are fixed phenomenological rates; each spin independently couples to selected Markov channels. No non-Markov bath, pulses, real-material fitting, or self-consistent bath feedback.

1/T₂ = γ₁/2 + γ_φ；仅描述无驱动、无耦合单自旋的横向包络: 1/T₂ = γ₁/2 + γ_φ; only the transverse envelope of an undriven, uncoupled single spin
纯度描述整体混合性；局部熵只有在整体纯态时才等于该二分划分的纠缠熵。: Purity measures global mixing; local entropy equals bipartite entanglement entropy only for a globally pure state.
非相互作用、相干、弹性、一维单轨道链，左右电极为相同的半无限均匀链；不是任意三维: Noninteracting, coherent, elastic, one-dimensional single-orbital chain with identical semi-infinite uniform leads; not an arbitrary 3D device or complete Kwant port.
局域态密度与注入密度按每个自旋、每 eV 给出；bondTransmission: LDOS and injectivity are per spin per eV; bondTransmission is left-incident normalized flux, not finite-bias current in amperes.

同一相容晶胞中的小位移、均匀应变分离、用户模式最小二乘与独立约化 Landau: Small displacements in one compatible cell, separation of homogeneous strain, least-squares user modes, and an independent reduced Landau teaching model.
母相与畸变相必须具有相同元素计数和原子数；先建立相容超胞: Parent/distorted phases must have equal element counts and atom counts; first construct compatible supercells

此参数组自由能无下界；有限绘图区的最低点不是全局平衡态。需要调整系数或加入稳定的: This free energy is unbounded below. The lowest plotted point is not global equilibrium; adjust coefficients or add stabilizing higher-order terms.
